subject.title: feat(ui): camera-off glyph and remembered camera state for talk calls

question: Should a previously successful in-call camera enable be remembered per gateway and automatically retried on later video-capable calls?
rationale: This is a new persistent user-behavior policy, not merely a rendering correction; source tests establish intended mechanics but cannot choose the desired privacy and convenience default.

options.title: Approve remembered device-local opt-in
options.body: Keep the proposed semantics because the preference becomes true only after a delivered stream and can be explicitly turned off.

options.title: Keep camera session-only
options.body: Merge the camera-off glyph but omit persistent auto-enable so every later call continues to require an explicit camera action.

recommendation.title: Approve remembered device-local opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed semantics because the preference becomes true only after a delivered stream and can be explicitly turned off.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged predecessor and this branch place this person closest to the talk-camera interaction design and implementation history.
